intended_object: The determinant map det : K₁(R) = GL(R)/E(R) → Rˣ for a commutative ring R. It is the homomorphism induced on the quotient of the stable general linear group by the stable elementary subgroup. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the module documentation.
explanation:
`StableGL R` is the direct limit of GL(Fin n, R) along the block stabilisation g ↦ diag(g, 1), which is the standard GL(R). `stableElementarySubgroup R` is the supremum of the images of the finite elementary subgroups, which is E(R). `det R` is obtained by lifting the compatible family of finite determinants; compatibility is the fact that det(diag(g, 1)) = det g. Elementary matrices have determinant 1, so `QuotientGroup.lift` applies and gives the induced map GL(R)/E(R) → Rˣ. This is exactly the classical determinant on K₁(R).

Commutativity of R is needed for the determinant to exist, so `CommRing` is the natural generality. Mathlib has no K₁ and no stable GL, so there is no broader counterpart. The library also proves this map agrees with the determinant on the abelianization through the canonical equivalence.
